note: Machine-readable mechanic map. One entry per analysed mechanic so a future agent does not have to rediscover the codebase. Line ranges verified against the tree at the time of writing; re-verify with grep before relying on them. Companions: MECHANIC_FINDINGS.md (report), MECHANIC_ATLAS.html (interactive). Amended after an adversarial verification pass: the 'protectionism protects industry' reading was WRONG and has been corrected.

mechanics.one_line: Weekly closing of nation.gold plus the nine policy dials that steer it; owns the dials, collects everything else.
mechanics.structural_fact: TWO parallel accounting objects both write nation.gold: nation.budget (cities.js nationBudget, crown gold + army wages + administration) and nation.economy (fiscalBalance, taxes + tariffs + social + construction + debt). updateLedger re-imports three lines from the first into the second so the screen shows one statement.

measurements.protocol: scripts/audit/harness.mjs; process-isolated scenarios; seeds ix-a/ix-b/ix-c; warmup 60 weeks as AI then 260 measured weeks as player; wars suppressed unless noted; lever re-applied weekly; medians reported
measurements.control_integrity: PASS - every dial set once at week 0 on a player nation is unchanged after 260 weeks. On an AI nation all dials drift to doctrine (tax.lower 0->35, tariff 0->100, admin 30->100, wages 25->85, proc 25->65, edu 90->100, welfare 100->0). The AI never touches the player's budget unless delegation('budget'|'trade') is on; delegation defaults to false (delegation.js emptyDelegation).
measurements.ledger_identity_L9: PASS ON THE HOT PATH - deviation 0.00 for 12 consecutive weeks. BUT L9 is asserted only in ACCOUNTING_INVARIANTS.md and scripts/audit/, never checked in src/, and FOUR refund paths credit the treasury without booking a ledger entry: economy.js dropInvalidProjects 2100 (state branch; the private branch 2097-2099 is correct - asymmetry inside one if/else), recruitment.js cancelTraining 475 (no outlayGold decrement), construction.js cancelConstruction 615-617 (correction clamped at 0 while projectGold is zeroed weekly at 3554), construction.js 906-909 (no correction at all). None fired in the measured window.

tariff.evidence: treasury 2,482 (-15%) -> 53,022 (50%) = 21x; needsMet 0.943 -> 0.700; revenue saturates near 50%. CORRECTION: the tariff does NOT protect domestic industry. settleGlobalTrade() 3310 fixes domestic = min(marketProduction, demand) BEFORE the tariff is read; the tariff only scales the import bid and the export surplus, and producers are paid the bare world price. Factory levels measured 40/39/39/40 across tariff 0..100 - flat. The 32-level outlier is the -15 run whose treasury was drained to 2,482 with a weekly net of -11, so it could not pay construction's hard gold gate. Causal chain is tariff -> treasury -> construction budget, not tariff -> price protection.

tax.middle.evidence: 0 vs 100: middle population 152k -> 105k, satisfaction 0.695 -> 0.431; distinct from the other two only in weight, but the demotion outcome differs MECHANISM IS SHARED: the only middle-specific constants in the whole budget path are the welfare relief rate (economy.js 2582, lower 0.35 / middle 0.12 / upper 0) and the AI tax ceiling (2873, 35/42/45). Everything else is one code path parameterised by a table. Middle is also the only class whose share of the tax base shrinks as the country industrialises (WAGE_SPLIT gives it 0.2 of payroll; all factory profit goes to upper).

militaryWages.evidence: 25 vs 60: army power 47.9 -> 59.3, defence 63.1 -> 78.2, cost 2.25 -> 5.40; in war soldiers 7,906 -> 8,550

militaryProcurement.evidence: 25 vs 60: supplyIndex 0.133 -> 0.228, arms 23.8 -> 27.4; cross-test wages100/proc25 vs wages25/proc100 gives completely different states, so the two are NOT one axis

welfare.evidence: 0 vs 100: lower satisfaction 0.580 -> 0.807, stability 0.544 -> 0.760, GDP 788 -> 843, and the treasury ends HIGHER (56,723 -> 57,880)

education.evidence: 30-year run: literacy 0.195 -> 0.514 (2.6x), research points 2.00 -> 3.57 (+79%), technologies completed 8 -> 9. One extra tech in 30 years for 40% of the treasury and 11% of GDP. Mathematically large, strategically flat. The discrete education GATE (construction.js investmentBlocker 531-536) is the part that matters.

adminFunding.evidence: every non-fiscal outcome byte-identical across 30-100. Marginal revenue 0.45*grossTax = 16.83 vs marginal cost 5.00. 100 is optimal unless gross tax < 11.1/week or population > ~2.9M (measured nation: 919,187).

health.evidence: 0 vs 100: +34 gold/week for +0.66% population over 5 years and zero city growth; standardOfLiving 15.06 -> 17.43

subsidyPolicy.evidence: manual/strategic/none are bit-identical in peacetime (subsidised plants 0, cost 0, GDP 792, treasury 52,404 in all three). Subsidies themselves work: force-marking all plants gives +12% employment, +3.8% GDP for 1.6% of the treasury.

treasury_as_constraint.evidence: held at 0 gold: factory levels 40 -> 24, GDP 792 -> 597. Given +100,000 gold: identical industry, GDP and project count. Peaceful treasuries reach 52k-250k with no sink. With wars enabled over 50 years: 29/29 nations borrowed, 27/29 defaulted, 10.46% of nation-weeks borrowing.

findings.claim: Protectionism does not protect domestic industry - there is no mechanism by which a tariff raises domestic sales or the price a domestic producer receives
findings.proof: settleGlobalTrade() 3310 domestic = min(marketProduction, flow.demand) is computed BEFORE the tariff; appetite (3319) scales only bidCol (imports), access (3323) only surplusCol (exports). Measured factory levels flat at 40/39/39/40 across tariff 0..100. The screens.js:1746 slider note claims otherwise.

findings.claim: Both party trade tooltips quote the wrong tariff caps
findings.proof: politics.js 25-26 say free trade caps at 10% and protectionism reaches 50%; fiscalPolicyLimits() 195-198 enforces 25% and 100%

findings.claim: A subsidised factory can never level up
findings.proof: economy.js 2409 sets factory.profit = 0 for a subsidised plant; autoUpgradeFactory() 1985 is `if (factory.profit <= 0) return false;`. The tooltip promises loss cover and does not mention the freeze.

findings.claim: Every per-programme social cost figure on the budget screen is wrong
findings.proof: screens.js socialShare() 188-194 splits ledger.socialCost by SLIDER VALUE share; socialSpendingCost() 1797-1807 weights each programme by its own rate (education 0.34, health 0.30, welfare 0.46) and adds reformModifiers.socialBurden, which belongs to no slider

findings.claim: The three per-class tax boxes do not sum into the Total income line beside them
findings.proof: socialClass.taxPaid is set at economy.js 2708 BEFORE taxes *= taxEfficiency(nation) at 2716; screens.js taxRow() 1571-1586 renders the pre-efficiency value. At adminFunding 30 the boxes overstate by 1/0.685 = 1.46x

findings.claim: The budget screen's 'recovery' note drops the supply term of the real formula
findings.proof: screens.js 1685 shows 0.6 + 0.4*wages/100; turn.js 419-423 uses (0.6+0.4*wages)*(0.7+0.3*supplyIndex). Measured supplyIndex is 0.13-0.25, so the UI overstates recovery in the normal case.

findings.proof: units.js upkeepWeight() 24-26 and regimentCount() 111-113 both return unit?.regiments?.length ?? 1. nationBudget() accumulates the same number into `army` and `armyWeight`.

findings.proof: cities.js growCities() 159-163 accumulates city.growth; save.js 189-190 persists pop and pops only, and the load path at 353 restores pops. Up to a full population point is lost per save.

findings.claim: warStrain cuts the ruling party's support by up to 45% and no UI surface names that channel
findings.proof: politics.js 238-244 `score *= 1 - Math.min(0.45, strain*0.3 + occupied*0.4)`. hud.js stabilityWhy() 1167-1183 shows war exhaustion's effect on STABILITY only; this is a separate channel straight into elections.

findings.claim: Welfare reaches the same province-growth endpoint the UI attributes exclusively to health

findings.proof: turn.js turnSteps(): workers/growCities is phase 9, economy is phase 11. growCities() 154-157 reads standardOfLiving and budget.net.food, both written later in the same week.

do_not_touch: tariff band + IMPORT_ELASTICITY 1.6 + EXPORT_RETALIATION 0.5 - the only genuine strategic dilemma in the budget, and party-dependent
the three class tax sliders - three different failure modes (starvation / demotion / class annihilation)
the militaryWages vs militaryProcurement split - proven distinct by cross-test
settleDebt + creditPenalty - inert in peace, decisive in war (27/29 nations default over 50 years); 6 consumers outside economy.js

updateLedger's L9 identity - exact to 0.00 on the hot path and the only thing making the budget auditable. Keep it, but note it is asserted in markdown, not enforced in code, and four refund paths bypass it.
hud.js stabilityWhy() 1167-1183 - a model of exposing a hidden calculation

top_traps: economy.fiscalNet is not one number - its value depends on the phase you read it in, and both meanings are live
nation.gold has no single owner - grepping fiscalBalance finds 1 of 13 writers
policy fields are read three different ways (socialLevel() accessor, raw economy.social.x in provinces.js, economy.social.x in screens.js) so an accessor grep misses two thirds of consumers

contract.inputs: nation.economy.{taxes.{lower,middle,upper}, tariff, militaryWages, militaryProcurement, adminFunding, social.{education,health,welfare}, subsidyPolicy}
contract.canonical_state: nation.gold, nation.debt, nation.economy.creditPenalty, and the nine input fields above. Everything else is recomputed weekly.
contract.derived: economy.{fiscalNet, taxRevenue, tariffRevenue, socialCost, constructionUpkeep, ledger}, nation.budget
contract.outputs: weekly nation.gold delta; class income/taxPaid/satisfaction; creditPenalty
invariants: delta nation.gold == ledger.net + ledger.borrowed - ledger.repaid + ledger.defaulted (L9, verified 0.00)
tariff revenue == importValue * tariff/100 (L8); domestic consumption is never tariffed
nation.gold >= 0 after settleDebt (the deficit becomes debt, then default)
a dial is only ever written through setFiscalPolicy - except adjustSocialAI 2742-2801, which writes economy.social directly
contract.may_read: any system may read nation.gold, economy.ledger, economy.stability, creditPenalty and the dial values
contract.must_not_write: no system outside economy.js/setFiscalPolicy may write the nine dials; only the 13 listed sites may write nation.gold; nothing outside settleDebt may write nation.debt or creditPenalty
contract.phase_order: produce() -> economy(begin -> per-nation -> finish) -> construction+politics. Read economy.fiscalNet only AFTER finishEconomy, or you get the pre-tariff value.
